events.enhanced_description: 2026 Colombian parliamentary election: President Gustavo Petro's party Historic Pact wins a plurality of seats in the Chamber of Representatives and the Senate.
events.name: 2026 Colombian parliamentary election

events.enhanced_description: India beats New Zealand in the 2026 Men's T20 World Cup final and secures its third title.
events.name: India wins the 2026 Men’s T20 World Cup

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Iran war: The United States Air Force conducts a large bombing raid on Kharg Island, a key oil export hub off the Persian Gulf coast of Iran.
events.name: U.S. bombing raid on Kharg Island

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Kazakh constitutional referendum: The new Constitution of Kazakhstan is accepted with 90% in favor.

image.caption: Map showing results of the Kazakh constitutional referendum by region.
image.date_qualification: Regional results map for the 15 March 2026 referendum; the saved original image date is 2026-03-21, after the vote.
image.rights_statement: LicenseShortName: CC BY 4.0; UsageTerms: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; Copyrighted: True

events.name: Kazakhstan approves a new constitution

events.enhanced_description: 2026 North Korean parliamentary election: General Secretary Kim Jong Un's Workers' Party wins a landslide majority in the Supreme People's Assembly.
events.name: 2026 North Korean parliamentary election

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Vietnamese legislative election: The Communist Party led by General Secretary Tô Lâm wins almost all the seats in the National Assembly of Vietnam.
events.name: 2026 Vietnamese legislative election

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Republic of the Congo presidential election: Incumbent President Denis Sassou Nguesso wins reelection in a landslide victory.
events.name: Denis Sassou Nguesso wins reelection in Congo

events.enhanced_description: A Lockheed C-130 of the Colombian Aerospace Force crashes near Puerto Leguízamo, Colombia, killing 69 people.
events.name: Colombian military aircraft crashes near Puerto Leguízamo

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Danish general election: Incumbent Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen's coalition loses its majority in the Folketing.
events.name: 2026 Danish general election

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Iran war: Iran's Ministry of Foreign Affairs states in a letter to the United Nations that ships not tied to either the United States or Israel can pass through the Strait of Hormuz.
events.name: Iran outlines conditions for Strait of Hormuz passage

events.enhanced_description: NASA launches the Artemis II lunar flyby mission, marking the first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972.
events.name: Artemis II launches on lunar flyby mission

events.enhanced_description: The crew of Artemis II breaks the record for the furthest humans have ever been from Earth, reaching a maximum distance of 252,756 miles (406,771 km) as they travel around the far side of the Moon.
events.name: Artemis II crew sets human distance record

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Vietnamese presidential election: The National Assembly of Vietnam elects General Secretary Tô Lâm as the new president of Vietnam, replacing Lương Cường.
events.name: Tô Lâm elected president of Vietnam

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Iran war: Following an ultimatum from Trump regarding the Strait of Hormuz, the United States and Iran agree on a two-week ceasefire.
events.name: United States and Iran agree to a two-week ceasefire

events.enhanced_description: Israel launches a series of airstrikes across Lebanon, targeting Hezbollah infrastructure. More than 300 people are killed and over 1,100 injured.

image.caption: Beirut following Israeli attacks.
image.date_qualification: The description identifies this as a tour after the attacks; the saved image date is 2026-04-08.
image.rights_statement: LicenseShortName: CC BY-SA 4.0; UsageTerms: Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 4.0; Copyrighted: True

events.name: Israeli airstrikes across Lebanon

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Djiboutian presidential election: Incumbent President Ismaïl Omar Guelleh is re-elected for a sixth term.
events.name: Ismaïl Omar Guelleh reelected in Djibouti

events.enhanced_description: The crew of Artemis II successfully returns to Earth, splashing down safely in the Pacific Ocean near San Diego, California, United States. The four crew members are extracted from the capsule and taken by helicopter to the USS John P. Murtha.
events.name: Artemis II crew returns to Earth

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Hungarian parliamentary election: Incumbent Prime Minister Viktor Orbán loses re-election in a landslide to Péter Magyar's Tisza Party, ending 16 years of Fidesz–KDNP rule.
events.name: Péter Magyar defeats Viktor Orbán in Hungarian election

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Beninese presidential election: Independent candidate Romuald Wadagni wins in a landslide with over 94% of the vote.
events.name: Romuald Wadagni wins Beninese presidential election

events.enhanced_description: Tornado outbreak sequence of April 23–28, 2026: An EF4 tornado hits the Vance Air Force Base in Enid, Oklahoma, injuring one person and damaging or destroying homes.

image.caption: Map of confirmed United States tornadoes during the outbreak sequence.
image.date_qualification: Map compiled after the outbreak sequence; the supplied image date is 2026-10-21, not the date of the depicted tornadoes.
image.rights_statement: LicenseShortName: CC BY-SA 4.0; UsageTerms: Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 4.0; Copyrighted: True

events.name: Tornado strikes Vance Air Force Base

events.enhanced_description: The United Arab Emirates leaves OPEC, ending six decades of membership and removing one of the organization's largest oil producers.
events.name: United Arab Emirates leaves OPEC

events.enhanced_description: An explosion at a fireworks factory in Liuyang, Hunan, China kills 37 people and injures 51 others.

image.caption: Aftermath of the Liuyang fireworks plant explosion, shown in a still image.
image.credit: 中国新闻社 — 直击湖南浏阳烟花厂爆炸事故现场：民房玻璃震碎 消防彻夜救援
image.date_qualification: Aftermath imagery dated 2026-05-05, the day after the 2026-05-04 explosion; not a contemporaneous image of the blast.
image.rights_statement: LicenseShortName: CC BY 4.0; UsageTerms: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; Copyrighted: True

events.name: Liuyang fireworks factory explosion

events.enhanced_description: Sudanese civil war: Rapid Support Forces launch drone attacks at several targets in Khartoum, Sudan, including the Khartoum International Airport in Khartoum, Sudan. Drone strikes are also reported at the Signal Corps in Khartoum Bahri and Al-Markhiyat camp in northern Omdurman. Additionally, the Sudan Army's air defenses intercept drone strikes at the airport.
events.name: Drone attacks target Khartoum and nearby sites

events.enhanced_description: Gaza war: An Israeli strike assassinates Izz al-Din al-Haddad, commander of the Izz al-Din al-Qassam Brigades and leader of Hamas in the Gaza Strip.
events.name: Israeli strike kills Hamas commander al-Haddad

events.enhanced_description: Former First Secretary of the Communist Party of Cuba Raúl Castro is indicted by the United States over the 1996 shootdown of Brothers to the Rescue aircraft.
events.name: United States indicts Raúl Castro

events.enhanced_description: The 2026 European heatwaves begin, bringing record-breaking temperatures to several European countries and causing thousands of deaths over the next several weeks.
events.name: European heatwaves begin

events.enhanced_description: A gas explosion at the Liushenyu coal mine in Shanxi, China, kills 82 people.
events.name: Liushenyu coal mine explosion

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Guinean parliamentary election: Parties supporting incumbent President Mamady Doumbouya win the election.
events.name: 2026 Guinean parliamentary election

events.enhanced_description: Flamingo Revolution: Following small protests in the village of Zvërnec, major protests erupt in Albania over a proposed luxury development involving Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner and his firm Affinity Partners, as well as broader discontent with Prime Minister Edi Rama's government.
events.name: Flamingo Revolution protests spread in Albania

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Armenian parliamentary election: The Civil Contract, led by incumbent Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan, wins reelection.
events.name: 2026 Armenian parliamentary election

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Kosovan parliamentary election: Amid the ongoing political deadlock, Vetëvendosje, led by incumbent Prime Minister Albin Kurti, wins a plurality of seats.
events.name: 2026 Kosovan parliamentary election

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Peruvian general election: Popular Force leader Keiko Fujimori narrowly defeats Together for Peru leader Roberto Sánchez in the presidential runoff. Left-wing parties gain a majority in the Chamber of Deputies but tie in the reestablished Senate.
events.name: Keiko Fujimori wins Peruvian presidential runoff

events.enhanced_description: A powerful magnitude 7.8 earthquake strikes the Philippines, the strongest in the country since 1976. 107 are killed and 1,320 are injured.

image.caption: Highway in Glan, Sarangani, following the Mindanao earthquake.
image.credit: Office of the Vice Mayor, Municipal Government of Glan, Sarangani — Vice Mayor James Yap Jr.
image.date_qualification: Image date is 2026-06-08; depicts aftermath, not the earthquake itself.
image.rights_statement: LicenseShortName: Public domain; UsageTerms: Public domain; Copyrighted: False

events.name: Magnitude 7.8 earthquake strikes the Philippines

events.enhanced_description: In Barcelona, Spain, the blessing ceremony of the Sagrada Família's tallest tower by Pope Leo XIV is held, exactly 100 years after the death of architect Antoni Gaudí. Pope Leo XIV consecrates and opens the central tower of Jesus Christ. The Sagrada Família is the world's tallest church.
events.name: Sagrada Família’s central tower opens

events.enhanced_description: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration declares the onset of an El Niño event in the tropical Pacific, and forecasts a 63% chance that it will rank among the largest since records began in 1950.

image.caption: Maps show common El Niño effects on global climate patterns during Northern Hemisphere winter and summer.
image.credit: Content published by Rebecca Lindsey and reviewed by Tom Di Liberto. Image credit to NOAA Climate.gov — Global impacts of El Niño and La Niña . Archived from the original on 4 June 2016 .
image.date_qualification: Published 9 February 2016; contextual climate maps, not a depiction of the NOAA declaration or a specific El Niño event.
image.rights_statement: LicenseShortName: Public domain; UsageTerms: Public domain; Copyrighted: False

events.name: NOAA declares the onset of El Niño

events.enhanced_description: Elon Musk becomes the first US dollar trillionaire with the initial public offering of SpaceX.
events.name: SpaceX offering makes Elon Musk a trillionaire

events.enhanced_description: A mid-air collision between two helicopters in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, kills six people, including American singer-songwriter Oliver Tree, Argentine YouTuber Gaspi, Argentine director and screenwriter Lucas A. Vignale and Brazilian music producer Lucas Frota.
events.name: Rio de Janeiro helicopter collision

events.enhanced_description: Keir Starmer announces his resignation as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, prompting a leadership election.
events.name: Keir Starmer announces resignation

events.enhanced_description: Two consecutive earthquakes with magnitudes of Mw 7.2 and Mw 7.5 shake western Venezuela. At least 6,500 people are killed, with thousands injured or missing and widespread damage across the country.

image.caption: USGS ShakeMap for the magnitude 7.5 earthquake west of Catia La Mar, Venezuela.
image.date_qualification: A ShakeMap associated with the 2026-06-24 mainshock; it is a map, not a photograph of the earthquakes.
image.rights_statement: LicenseShortName: Public domain; UsageTerms: Public domain; Copyrighted: False

events.name: Two major earthquakes strike western Venezuela

events.enhanced_description: The 2026 Algerian parliamentary election is held.
events.name: 2026 Algerian parliamentary election

events.enhanced_description: Hamas announces the resignation of its civil administration under the Gaza peace plan.
events.name: Hamas announces civil administration’s resignation

events.enhanced_description: The International Olympic Committee lifts the ban on the Russian Olympic Committee, allowing its athletes to participate in future Olympic Games.
events.name: IOC lifts ban on Russian Olympic Committee

events.enhanced_description: 2026 São Toméan presidential election: Incumbent President Carlos Vila Nova is reelected for a second term.
events.name: Carlos Vila Nova reelected president

events.enhanced_description: 2026 FIFA World Cup final: Spain beat defending champions Argentina 1–0 during extra time to win a second FIFA World Cup title after 16 years. Spanish forward Ferran Torres scores the only goal in the 106th minute.

image.caption: Spain's players lift the World Cup trophy after the final.
image.date_qualification: Contemporary celebration photograph associated with the final; image date is 2026-07-19.
image.rights_statement: LicenseShortName: CC BY-SA 4.0; UsageTerms: Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 4.0; Copyrighted: True; Restrictions: personality

events.name: Spain wins the 2026 FIFA World Cup

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Iran war: The Houthis announce a maritime blockade against Saudi Arabia on the Bab el-Mandeb strait.
events.name: Houthis announce blockade against Saudi Arabia

events.enhanced_description: An earthquake strikes Kumamoto Prefecture in southern Japan with a magnitude of Mww 6.8 (MJMA 7.1) at a depth of 10 km (6.2 mi), killing at least 30 and injuring over 60.
events.name: Earthquake strikes Kumamoto Prefecture

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Iran war: Saudi Arabia announces the establishment of a 14-nation military alliance to restore and protect freedom of navigation through the Red Sea amid the Iran conflict and ongoing crisis in the area stimulated by the Houthis.
events.name: Saudi Arabia announces a maritime military alliance

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Ceuta migrant crisis: Approximately 80,000 people illegally enter Ceuta, Spain with smaller numbers attempting to cross into Melilla, having swum from Morocco. This follows a Supreme Court of Spain decision prohibiting the hot return of migrants arriving by sea. At least 111 people are killed.
events.name: Ceuta migrant crisis

events.enhanced_description: An avalanche on Broad Peak in the Karakoram range of Pakistan kills ten climbers, including Nirmal Purja, Pur Bahadur Gurung, Nadhira Al Harthy and Kili Pemba Sherpa.
events.name: Broad Peak avalanche kills ten climbers

events.enhanced_description: Poland wins the 2026 FIVB Men's Volleyball Nations League, held in Ningbo, China, defeating the United States 3–2 in the final.
events.name: Poland wins the Men’s Volleyball Nations League

events.enhanced_description: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey sign the Mecca Defence Alliance, a mutual defence pact, amid the 2026 Iran war.
events.name: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey sign defence pact

events.enhanced_description: A powerful magnitude 7.4 earthquake strikes Colombia, killing 335 and injuring over 1,248 people.

image.caption: Building debris in Pereira, Colombia, photographed by World Central Kitchen.
image.date_qualification: Aftermath image from 2026-08-12, two days after the earthquake; it documents earthquake damage rather than the earthquake itself.
image.rights_statement: LicenseShortName: CC BY 4.0; UsageTerms: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; Copyrighted: True

events.name: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake strikes Colombia

events.enhanced_description: A ferry capsizing on Lake Kariba, Zimbabwe, kills at least 97 people, becoming the deadliest boat disaster in the country's history.
events.name: Lake Kariba ferry capsizes

events.enhanced_description: A total solar eclipse occurs in parts of Europe, the first in continental Europe since 1999.
events.name: Total solar eclipse crosses parts of Europe

events.enhanced_description: At least 142 people are killed and nearly 1,300 injured when a magnitude 7.8 earthquake strikes off the island of Flores, Indonesia.
events.name: Earthquake strikes off Flores

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Iran war: U.S. President Donald Trump announces an "Economic D-Day" against Iran, calling on allies to join efforts to isolate Iran economically.
events.name: Trump announces “Economic D-Day” against Iran

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Nepal–Tibet floods: At least 1,403 people are killed and 6,650 are reported missing after a landslide and glacial collapse trigger flash floods and debris flows at the border between Nepal and the Tibet Autonomous Region of China.
events.name: Nepal–Tibet floods

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Icelandic European Union membership negotiations referendum: A referendum to continue negotiations for Iceland to join the European Union is rejected.
events.name: Iceland rejects continuation of EU membership talks

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Nigerien coup attempt: A mutinous faction of the Niger Armed Forces called the Armed Forces for the Restoration of the Fatherland attempt a coup against president Abdourahamane Tiani.
events.name: Coup attempt in Niger

events.enhanced_description: The 2026 Estonian presidential election: Ülle Madise is elected president of Estonia by the Riigikogu.
events.name: Ülle Madise elected president of Estonia

events.enhanced_description: The United Nations votes to adopt a resolution which calls for wider use of the Equal Earth projection over the Mercator projection to better reflect the true size of equatorial regions such as Africa.

image.caption: Equal Earth world map with a 15° graticule, rendered using the Geocart map projection software.
image.date_qualification: Map illustrating the Equal Earth projection, created before the September 2026 United Nations resolution; it is not a depiction of the vote. Original image date: 2018-09-15 10:48:26.
image.rights_statement: LicenseShortName: CC BY-SA 4.0; UsageTerms: Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 4.0; Copyrighted: True

events.name: United Nations backs wider use of Equal Earth projection

events.enhanced_description: Twelve countries, including Canada, France and the United Kingdom, announce plans to introduce or support trade restrictions on goods from Israeli settlements, citing threats to a two-state solution.
events.name: Countries announce plans for Israeli settlement trade restrictions

events.enhanced_description: A fire on the ferry MV June Aster kills at least 76 people and 13 others go missing off Coron, Palawan, Philippines.
events.name: MV June Aster ferry fire

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Swedish general election: The left-wing bloc led by former Prime Minister and Social Democratic leader Magdalena Andersson narrowly wins a majority in the Riksdag.

image.caption: Social Democratic leader Magdalena Andersson poses after leaving Liseberg amusement park in Gothenburg, Sweden.
image.date_qualification: Portrait made during Andersson’s Gothenburg visit on 10 April 2026, before the 13 September 2026 election; it is contextual, not an election-event photograph.
image.rights_statement: LicenseShortName: CC BY 4.0; UsageTerms: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; Copyrighted: True

events.name: 2026 Swedish general election

events.enhanced_description: Indonesian ferry KM Virgo Transport 8 sinks in the Java Sea, killing 64 and leaving 71 missing.
events.name: Virgo Transport 8 sinks in the Java Sea

events.enhanced_description: The United States publicly acknowledges for the first time that it has deployed "space control weapons" in Earth orbit, with Air Force Secretary Troy Meink confirming that the United States Space Force possesses orbital weapons capable of offensive and defensive operations.
events.name: United States acknowledges orbital weapons

events.enhanced_description: 2026 French student protests: A series of student-led protests begin in Paris with students demanding better funding and resources for schools. In October these protests spread across France, with hundreds of thousands taking part and thousands arrested. The protests spread to multiple countries in Europe, taking on cost-of-living themes.
events.name: French student protests begin

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Moroccan general election: The Authenticity and Modernity Party led by Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri wins the most seats in the House of Representatives. Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri becomes Morocco's first female prime minister.
events.name: 2026 Moroccan general election

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Ethiopian offensive: The Tigray People’s Liberation Front and groups aligned with them launch a military offensive in northern Ethiopia against the Ethiopian Government, resuming the civil conflict.
events.name: TPLF and allies launch offensive in northern Ethiopia

events.enhanced_description: G7 leaders hold an emergency meeting to discuss global diesel supplies and agree to release 100 million barrels of oil, as prices surge to record highs amid disruption from the 2026 Iran war.
events.name: G7 agrees to release 100 million barrels of oil

events.enhanced_description: The 2026 Bosnian general election is held.
events.name: 2026 Bosnian general election

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Peshawar school roof collapse: The roof of a private school in Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, collapses, killing 35 people and injuring more than 50.
events.name: Peshawar school roof collapse

events.enhanced_description: Andorra and San Marino each sign an association agreement with the European Union.
events.name: Andorra and San Marino sign EU association agreements

events.enhanced_description: Sudanese civil war: A drone attack on a market in the disputed Abyei region kills at least 220 people.
events.name: Drone attack on a market in Abyei

events.enhanced_description: A mass shooting occurs in Karak, Jordan at a Greek Orthodox Church, killing nine people and injuring 34.

image.caption: CCTV footage shows the Karak church shooters entering the building.
image.date_qualification: The image description identifies CCTV footage of the shooters entering the building during the 23 October 2026 attack; pixels were not supplied or visually inspected.
image.rights_statement: LicenseShortName: Public domain; UsageTerms: Public domain; Copyrighted: False

events.name: Karak church mass shooting

events.enhanced_description: The Junior Eurovision Song Contest 2026 is held in Attard, Malta. Armenia wins their third contest with the song "Boo!" by Naré.

image.caption: Map of countries participating, intending to participate, or having previously participated in the Junior Eurovision Song Contest 2026.
image.credit: Irene014 — This file was derived from: Eurovision Junior Map 2023-2025.svg :
image.date_qualification: Map dated 2026-07-04; it shows participation status, not the contest event itself.
image.rights_statement: LicenseShortName: CC BY-SA 4.0; UsageTerms: Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 4.0; Copyrighted: True

events.name: Armenia wins Junior Eurovision 2026

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Brazilian general election: Incumbent president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defeats senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round in an upset victory, becoming the first president in Brazilian history to be re-elected to a fourth term and the first to win a second round after losing a first round. Right-leaning parties win majorities in the Chamber of Deputies and the Federal Senate.
events.name: Lula wins Brazilian presidential runoff

events.enhanced_description: 2026 Serbian parliamentary election: Following mass student protests, the Student List wins a majority in the National Assembly, defeating former president Aleksandar Vučić's United Serbia.

image.caption: Map showing preliminary winners by municipality and vote shares in Serbia’s parliamentary election.
image.credit: User:ImStevan , Byteflush ( talk ) — RIK ; based on File:2026 Serbian parliamentary election map.svg
image.date_qualification: Election-results map based on preliminary results; image date is 2026-10-26, the day after the election. It is not a contemporary event photograph.
image.rights_statement: LicenseShortName: CC BY-SA 4.0; UsageTerms: Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 4.0; Copyrighted: True

events.name: Student List wins Serbian parliamentary election

events.enhanced_description: At least 64 people are killed and hundreds injured when two high speed trains collide in Los Yébenes, Toledo, Spain.
events.name: High-speed trains collide in Los Yébenes, Spain

events.enhanced_description: The United States held midterm elections on November 3, 2026, contesting all 435 voting House seats and 35 Senate seats, along with state and territorial offices. The excerpt reports that Democrats gained control of both houses of Congress and a majority of governorships.
events.name: 2026 United States midterm elections
